title: GTA 6 scores 99 on Metacritic, tying the record 🏆
subject: gta6
description:
Does GTA 6 deserve the perfect scores? 👇

GTA 6 reviews went live on November 18 and the game debuted with a 99 on Metacritic, tied for the highest score in the site's history, plus a 98 top critic average on OpenCritic. GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S at 30 fps.

Sources: Kotaku (Nov 18, 2026), Video Games Chronicle (Nov 18, 2026), Tom's Guide review roundup
Game images © Rockstar Games.

scenes.text: Critics gave GTA 6 a 99 on Metacritic.
Reviews went live on November 18, and about 147 outlets weighed in.
That ties Metacritic's all-time record and beats GTA 4, the old series best at 98.
IGN's Luke Reilly called it the most impressive game he has ever played.
The main complaint: it runs at 30 frames per second on every console, PS5 Pro included.
